#Region "Main"
    COMMENT  This is the main entry point for the flow
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Welcome to PAD Analyzer!''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 => ButtonPressed
    DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime => CurrentDateTime
    SET CurrentDate TO %CurrentDateTime%
    Variables.SetVariable NewValue: %CurrentDate% Name: FormattedDate
    COMMENT  Now let's check some conditions
    IF %ButtonPressed% = OK
        Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''You clicked OK at %FormattedDate%''' Icon: Display.Icon.Information
    ELSE
        Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''You clicked something else''' Icon: Display.Icon.Warning
    END
    COMMENT  Let's loop through some items
    SET Counter TO 0
    LOOP WHILE %Counter% < 5
        Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: 1 Name: Counter
        Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Counter is now %Counter%'''
    END
#EndRegion
#Region "ProcessData"
    Excel.LaunchExcel Visible: True => ExcelInstance
    Excel.ReadFromExcelExcelFileToRead: CurrentExcelFile Instance: %ExcelInstance% ReadOption: Excel.ReadOption.CellRange Range: $'''A1:B10''' => ExcelData
    LOOP FOREACH CurrentRow IN %ExcelData%
        IF %CurrentRow['Status']% = Active
            COMMENT  Process active row
            Variables.SetVariable NewValue: %CurrentRow['Name']% Name: ActiveUserName
            Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Processing user: %ActiveUserName%'''
        END
    END
    Excel.CloseExcel Instance: %ExcelInstance% SaveBeforeClosing: True
#EndRegion
#Region "ErrorHandling"
    ON BLOCK ERROR
        COMMENT  Handle any errors that occur
        Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''An error occurred: %WorkflowError%''' Icon: Display.Icon.Error
        SET ErrorHandled TO True
    END
    WebAutomation.LaunchBrowser BrowserType: WebAutomation.BrowserType.Chrome => Browser
    WebAutomation.NavigateTo Url: $'''https://example.com''' BrowserInstance: %Browser%
    WebAutomation.ClickClick BrowserInstance: %Browser% Control: appmask['Submit Button']
    WebAutomation.CloseBrowser BrowserInstance: %Browser%
#EndRegion
